questions.quote: Ethanol is a colourless liquid, having a pleasant smell and a burning taste. It is a volatile liquid. Its boiling point is 78 °C (351 K) ... It is completely miscible with water in all proportions.

en.q: Which statement about ethanol is correct?
options: It has a lower boiling point than ethane
It is completely miscible with water in all proportions
It is a solid at room temperature
en.explanation: Its boiling point is 78 °C, much higher than that of ethane (184 K).

questions.quote: Comparison between soap and detergents: Soap - sodium salt of long chain fatty acids, –COO–Na+; forms scum in hard water; poor foaming; biodegradable. Detergent - sodium salts of sulphonic acids, –SO3–Na+; effective in hard water; rich foaming; most are non-biodegradable.

en.q:
Consider the following:
(i) Soaps are biodegradable.
(ii) Detergents have a rich foaming capacity.
(iii) Soaps form scum in hard water.
Which are correct?
en.explanation: All three statements are from the comparison table.

questions.quote: A group or class of organic compounds related to each other by a general molecular formula constitutes homologous series. The IUPAC name of any organic compound consists of three parts: ROOTWORD, PREFIX and/or SUFFIX.

en.q: The IUPAC name of an organic compound consists of
options: a prefix and a number only
only a root word with no more
only a suffix with no root
en.explanation: A homologous series is a group of compounds related by a general molecular formula.

questions.quote: The slow chemical change that takes place in complex organic compounds by the action of enzymes leading to the formation of simple molecules is called fermentation. en.q: Soaps are ____ salts of long-chain carboxylic acids, whereas detergents are sodium salts of ____ acids.
